name: Test of Endurance
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 2,450 experience instead of 2,400, 1.02 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.

First is a test of endurance. Go to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.
narrative.objectives: Bring Grenka's Claw to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
narrative.offerRewardText: Grenka was powerful, even by troll standards. You should be proud of your accomplishment this day.During your test of faith you displayed strength of spirit, and now you have shown endurance in battle by taking on the Roguefeather harpies, but the time has come for a new test.
narrative.requestItemsText: You must be prepared spiritually, physically and mentally for the challenges that lie ahead of you.Too often do we rush forward before we are ready. I consider it my duty to the youth, no matter which tribe they belong to, to prepare them for the dangers they may face after they leave the sanctity of their home.

quests.objectiveText: If you have faith, leap from the planks overlooking Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Test of Lore
